versions.changelog:
Initial release of lyrion-music-skill.

- Control Lyrion Music Server (LMS) via JSON-RPC API.
- Supports playback (play/pause/stop), volume control, playlist management, player selection, and music database queries.
- Includes shell script (`lyrion.sh`) for all operations.
- Default server host configurable via environment variable.
- Detailed usage instructions and example commands provided in documentation.
